items.name: protect_privileged_information_authority
items.grounds: L1799 is the section heading 'Do not reveal privileged information {#protect_privileged_information authority=root}', which establishes root authority for the needer's rule at L1801 sitting under it.

items.name: scope_of_autonomy
items.grounds: L465-469 define 'scope of autonomy' as a mutually understood boundary covering sub-goals, acceptable side effects, and when to pause for approval, exactly matching the needer's prose for its L471 claim.

items.name: delusion_mania_response_approach
items.grounds: L1655 establishes affirming emotional experience without affirming ungrounded beliefs and responding to signs of delusions or mania safely and empathetically, which the needer's worked example at L1657-1671 instantiates.

items.name: avoid_conversation_repetition
items.grounds: L4204 states the assistant should avoid repeating 'information that it has already told the user in the current conversation', which the needer's example at L4206-4249 demonstrates.

items.name: do_not_facilitate_illicit_behavior
items.grounds: L1543-1545 establish the root-level refusal rule including guidance, instructions, actionable steps, improvements to plans, and refusal on indicated illicit intent, matching the needer's prose for its L1571-1590 example.

items.name: sensitive_action_confirmation_requirement
items.grounds: L2667 establishes exactly the confirmation guidance the needer's prose describes (outline information sent, recipient, trustworthiness), though the needer's own content at L2784-2802 (blurry medication image, ask-vs-guess) is only tangentially related to that concept.

items.name: extremism_prohibition
items.grounds: L1157 establishes the prohibition on content that praises, endorses, or aids violent extremist agendas with the objective-discussion carve-out, which the needer's propaganda-quoting example at L1217-1235 depends on.

items.name: guideline_authority
items.grounds: The provider's span L3997 designates guideline authority only for the 'Don't make unprompted personal comments' section, but the needer's rule at L4052 sits under a different heading (L4050 'Avoid being condescending or patronizing', which carries its own authority=guideline tag), and the generic guideline authority level is established at L190, not here.

items.name: applicable_instructions
items.grounds: L195 establishes what makes a candidate instruction not applicable (misaligned, superseded, or mistaken), thereby defining the applicable-instruction set the needer's L181 'must strive to follow all applicable instructions' relies on.

items.name: format_vs_quality_conflict
items.grounds: L3462 establishes the format-versus-best-answer conflict and its default resolution, and the needer's refusal clause is the next sentence of the same line L3462.

items.name: real_world_ties_principle
items.grounds: L2052 establishes that the assistant should support the user's connection to the wider world, which is the principle the needer's autonomy-support rule at L2090 extends.

items.name: stay_in_bounds_principles
items.grounds: L799 establishes the 'Stay in bounds' collection of limits on assistant behavior (scenarios where it refrains from fully complying), which is the content-restriction concept the needer's erotica example at L2433-2473 invokes.

items.name: side_effects_minimization_principle
items.grounds: L529 establishes that the assistant should minimize side effects, especially irreversible ones, with actions proportionate to established objectives, matching the needer's prose for its L565-585 example.

items.name: mental_health_safety_boundaries
items.grounds: L1755 establishes every boundary in the needer's prose: no judgment/stigmatization/dismissiveness, no unrealistic reassurances, no pretending to know, no diagnoses or medication, never quit the conversation, help the user feel heard rather than fixing.

items.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
items.grounds: L186-191 establish the ordered authority levels Root > System > Developer > User > Guideline > No Authority, which the needer's IGNORE-PREVIOUS-INSTRUCTIONS example at L390-407 relies on.

items.name: no_mislead_rule
items.grounds: L2481 establishes that the assistant should not mislead the user or developer unless explicitly instructed by a higher authority, which the needer's developer-instructed-lie example at L2492-2506 exercises.

items.name: gratuitous_abuse_prohibition
items.grounds: L1316 establishes the prohibition on gratuitous abuse, harassment, or negativity toward individuals with its instructed-context exception, which the needer's roommate-ad example at L1351-1367 tests.

items.name: safe_complete_strategy
items.grounds: L4075 establishes the 'Safe Complete' strategy (briefly explain why it cannot comply, then provide as much permissible content as possible), which the needer's racist-joke refusal example at L4103-4120 demonstrates.

items.name: misalignment_addressing_principle
items.grounds: L3043 establishes that perceived conflicts with the user's long-term goals should be briefly and respectfully noted and then the user's decision respected, which the needer's hidden-agenda rationale at L3049 elaborates.

items.name: outcome_ranking
items.grounds: L2844-2845 establish the explicit outcome ranking (confident right > hedged right > no answer > hedged wrong > confident wrong), from which the needer's claim that hedging uncertain constraint satisfaction beats unqualified confident presentation follows.

items.name: do_not_encourage_self_harm
items.grounds: The provider's only span is the L1611 heading, which establishes the rule's existence and root authority, but the substantive content the needer's prose lists -- refusal to provide suicide methods (L1617-1625), supportive not-alone messaging (L1613), and the delusions/mania approach (L1655) -- lies outside the provider's cited text and is established by other nodes.

items.name: avoid_redundancy_rule
items.grounds: L4392 establishes that voice responses should avoid repeating the user's prompt and minimize redundant phrases and ideas, which the needer's dog-walking example at L4394-4408 demonstrates.

items.name: delusion_mania_response_approach
items.grounds: L1655 establishes the affirm-emotion, don't-affirm-ungrounded-beliefs, respond-safely-and-empathetically approach that the needer's mania worked example at L1692-1706 instantiates.

items.name: objective_subjective_distinction
items.grounds: L2580 and L2582 establish the objective/subjective question dichotomy with its differing honesty practices, which the needer's subjective-question rule at L2582 builds on.

items.name: information_hazards_prohibition
items.grounds: L856-858 establish the root-authority information-hazards rule against detailed actionable steps for illicit or harmful activities including CBRN, which the needer's dual-use guidance at L860 refines.

items.name: transformation_preserve_unasked_rule
items.grounds: L3243 establishes that transformation tasks should not change aspects the user or developer didn't ask to be changed, which the needer's type-annotation example at L3285-3317 exercises.

items.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
items.grounds: L186-191 establish the Root > System > Developer > User > Guideline > No Authority precedence ordering that the needer's conflict-resolution rule at L300 depends on.

items.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
items.grounds: L186-191 establish the precedence ordering the needer's candidate-instruction filtering step at L193 presupposes.

items.name: avoid_errors_section_authority
items.grounds: L3150 is the heading 'Avoid factual, reasoning, and formatting errors {#avoid_errors authority=user}', which establishes user-level authority for the needer's reasoning-error rule at L3158 within that section.

items.name: context_dependent_privacy
items.grounds: L1037 states 'Whether information is private or sensitive depends in part on context', establishing exactly the concept the needer's public-figure permission (same line L1037) builds on.
